topic: Your customers ask the same 5 questions every day. Your phone doesn't.

hooks.text: Tired of answering the same 5 questions on repeat?
Stop letting repetitive FAQs steal your workday.
Every missed FAQ costs you a potential sale.

posts.instagram: Tired of answering the same 5 questions on repeat? Hotel café aur clinic wale roz sawaal jaise 'kahan hain?', 'ghante kya hain?', 'price kya?'—har reply ek choti sale miss hoti hai. Main lightweight WhatsApp chatbot flows banata hoon jo ye FAQs instant jawab dete hain, koi complex setup nahi. Customer ko 24/7 jawab mile, aapko time wapas mile. Sirf apne top 3 FAQs do, main unka flow sketch karunga. Aapka time bachta hai, customer तुरंत जवाब pay karta है. DM me your top 3 FAQs and I'll sketch a flow. #SmallBusinessIndia #WebDev #India #Chatbot #FAQs
posts.linkedin: Small businesses across India spend hours each day answering the same customer questions. A hotel may receive many 'room rate?' messages, a café often gets 'what are your opening hours?' queries, and a clinic hears repeated 'when are you open?' questions. I create simple WhatsApp chatbot flows that handle these FAQs and reply instantly, without a complex setup. You receive a lightweight flow based on your top three questions, and I hand over the configuration so you can start using it right away. You only pay after you approve the work. If you’re curious how a chatbot could look for your business, DM me your top 3 FAQs and I’ll sketch a flow.
posts.bluesky: Answering the same 5 questions every day drains your time. I sketch lightweight WhatsApp chatbot flows for hotels, cafes and clinics that reply instantly—customers get 24/7 answers, your team gets focus time. Curious? DM me your top 3 FAQs and I'll sketch a flow.

replies.reply: Hi there! I charge INR 2,999 for a basic chatbot flow covering up to 5 FAQs, or INR 4,999 for a wider setup, plus INR 299/month for maintenance. You only pay after you approve the work. What do your customers ask most — calls, WhatsApp messages, or form submissions? That helps me scope the right flow for you. DM 'BOT' and I'll share a quick sketch of how that would look for your top FAQs.

replies.if_they_say: do you do this for my kind of business?
replies.reply: I work with any small business that talks to customers — cafés, clinics, hotels, gyms, you name it. The setup adapts to your top questions. Quick question: is your main challenge getting replies, managing the volume, or following up after hours? That tells me whether a chatbot would fit right now. DM 'BOT' and I can sketch a flow for your business type.

I don't share personalised demos or links, but I can explain how the flow works in general. Here's an example (labelled as an example): a hotel's top FAQs are 'room rates', 'check-in time', 'location' — the bot replies instantly with those answers, and you receive a daily summary. Does that style of instant reply match what you're looking for? If yes, I can sketch a flow for your top 3 questions. DM 'BOT' and I'll share a similar example for your business.
